tools.name: get_city_stats
tools.description: Get detailed Thai restaurant statistics for any UK city. Returns restaurant count, hygiene rating, density per 100k population, dine-in vs takeaway breakdown, and market size classification.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Search individual Thai restaurants by city, type, or minimum hygiene rating. Returns named restaurants with address, postcode, rating, and inspection date. Perfect for finding top-rated Thai restaurants in any UK city.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find Thai restaurants near a UK postcode. Geocodes the postcode, calculates driving distances, and returns the best-rated restaurants within your radius. Perfect for 'find Thai near me' queries.

tools.name: get_uk_overview
tools.description: Get overall UK Thai restaurant market statistics: total businesses, market size, growth rate, average hygiene, and national wage data.

tools.name: compare_cities
tools.description: Compare Thai restaurant statistics between two UK cities side by side.

tools.name: rank_cities
tools.description: Rank UK cities by Thai restaurant count, hygiene rating, or density per 100k. Returns top N cities with full stats.

tools.name: get_opening_costs
tools.description: Get estimated cost breakdown for opening a Thai restaurant in the UK: lease, refurbishment, equipment, licenses, and working capital.

tools.name: get_delivery_rates
tools.description: Get current delivery platform commission rates for Uber Eats (30%), Deliveroo (32%), and Just Eat (14%). Includes typical menu markups.

tools.name: get_visa_info
tools.description: Get Skilled Worker visa costs and requirements for hiring Thai chefs. Includes minimum salary (£38,700), processing times, and first-year cost estimates.

tools.name: get_market_health
tools.description: Get a comprehensive market health assessment: competition levels by city, cost pressures (wages, NI, ingredients), growth opportunities, and key risks for operators.
